hints.tr: İki ortalama: `sum(probabilities) / len(probabilities)` ve aynısı etiketler için.
hints.en: Two means: `sum(probabilities) / len(probabilities)` and the same for the labels.
The order matters: expected minus actual.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
def calibration_gap(probabilities, labels):
    expected = sum(probabilities) / len(probabilities)
    actual = sum(labels) / len(labels)
    return round(expected - actual, 3)


print(calibration_gap([0.2, 0.4, 0.6], [0, 1, 0]))
print(calibration_gap([0.5, 0.5], [1, 0]))
print(calibration_gap([0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 0.1], [1, 1, 0, 0]))
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

```python
def calibration_gap(probabilities, labels):
    expected = sum(probabilities) / len(probabilities)
    actual = sum(labels) / len(labels)
    return round(expected - actual, 3)


print(calibration_gap([0.2, 0.4, 0.6], [0, 1, 0]))
print(calibration_gap([0.5, 0.5], [1, 0]))
print(calibration_gap([0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 0.1], [1, 1, 0, 0]))
```
